note: Every organisation, place, person, figure and sentence in this file is invented. Hosts use the reserved .example top-level domain. Nothing here is, or is derived from, a real source.

cases.title: A closure with an ordinary "City, State" place
cases.rationale: A closure is intelligence and must be recorded, as a negative signal, however the place is punctuated.

documents.title: A closure with an ordinary "City, State" place
documents.text: Halvard Snacks said it will close its Winterhold, Ohio plant in March 2027, affecting 300 employees.

cases.title: A closure the classifier does recognise
cases.rationale: A recorded closure is a NEGATIVE signal. By itself it opens no pursuit opportunity; relocation or remediation work needs separate physical evidence.

documents.title: A closure the classifier does recognise
documents.text: Halvard Snacks will close its Winterhold processing plant in 2027, affecting 300 employees, at a restructuring cost of $40 million.

cases.title: A consolidation of production
cases.rationale: Moving production out of one site is a closure-type event, not a growth project, even though the destination plant is named.

documents.title: A consolidation of production
documents.text: Kestrelwood Dairy Cooperative announced it will consolidate production from its Dunmere Hollow creamery into its Ashgrove Mill plant by 2028, saving $15 million annually.
